title: Temporal Specification Guidance for Text-to-Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.20822v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Text-to-video models often generate the visual concepts requested in natural language prompts but fail to satisfy their intended ordering, timing, and persistence requirements. We propose representing these requirements as specifications in a formal Temporal Logic, and introduce Temporal Specification Guidance (TSG), a training-free inference-time framework that turns temporal specifications into executable objectives for guiding video generation during sampling. TSG scores traces of visual concept evidence using differentiable quantitative semantics and uses the score's gradients to construct a specification-guided denoising direction. We instantiate this framework with video-text attention traces, efficient differentiable scores for Metric Temporal Logic, and gradient-derived attention biases. translated_title: 文生视频生成中的时序规范引导
translated_abstract: 文生视频模型通常能够生成自然语言提示中所要求的视觉概念，但往往无法满足这些概念在顺序、时序和持续性方面的预期要求。我们提出将这些要求表示为形式化时序逻辑中的规范，并引入时序规范引导，这是一个免训练的推理时框架，它将时序规范转化为可执行的目标，用于在采样过程中引导视频生成。TSG 使用可微的定量语义对视觉概念证据的轨迹进行评分，并利用该评分的梯度构建规范引导的去噪方向。我们通过视频-文本注意力轨迹、度量时序逻辑的高效可微评分以及由梯度导出的注意力偏置来实例化该框架。这一实例化既不需要外部概念分类器，也不需要通过视频 Transformer 进行反向传播。其注意力引导的前向……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出时序规范引导——一个免训练的推理时框架，通过将形式化时序逻辑规范转化为可微评分并利用其梯度引导去噪方向，使文生视频模型能够满足提示中概念在时间顺序、时序与持续性方面的要求。
en_tdlr: Proposes Temporal Specification Guidance (TSG), a training-free inference-time framework that converts formal temporal logic specifications into differentiable scores and gradient-guided denoising directions, enabling text-to-video models to satisfy the ordering, timing, and persistence requirements of prompts.
